name: Godrick Farsan
summary: In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Forsaken warlocks beside Carendin Halgar. Though blind, he says he sees in a different way.

sections.title: Eyes in the Dark
sections.body: Among the summoning circles in the Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Master Carendin Halgar as he guides aspiring Forsaken warlocks. Godrick is blind, yet says he sees in a different way and does not explain how. He tests those who seek to bind greater demons, sending them to gather pure hearts and essences for intricate summoning rites.

faq.answer: Godrick Farsan is a Forsaken warlock in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter. He assists Master Carendin Halgar in teaching fledgling warlocks and guiding their rituals.

faq.q: How can Godrick see if he is blind?
faq.answer: Godrick Farsan says he sees in a different way despite his blindness. He does not explain how.

faq.q: Is Godrick related to Strahad Farsan?
faq.answer: Godrick Farsan and Strahad Farsan share a surname, but no family connection is confirmed.

faq.q: What role does he play in warlock training?
faq.answer: Godrick Farsan guides warlocks through binding rites, including acquiring pure hearts to lure and bind a succubus.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can consult Godrick to prepare lures for summoning a succubus and learn the devouring nature of demonic servants.
As an undead, you can see Godrick embracing physical ruin and blindness while honing dark magical awareness to replace mortal frailties.
